# SPXW short-premium study v2 (complete chains, Cboe settlement): results (generated by report.py)

Generated 2026-10-14 03:21 UTC from `results/`.  Design: `../spxw/PREREGISTRATION.md`, unchanged; the two input changes and the added analyses are listed in `README.md` (protocol hash in `protocol_sha256.txt`).  P&L in $ per 1-lot (one contract per leg), sell at the NBBO bid / buy at the ask, $1.00 per contract per side, settlement at the official Cboe SPX close; 95 % intervals are day-clustered percentile bootstraps (5,000 draws, seed 7).  "v1" = the round-2 study (`../spxw/results`, ±2 % band chains, 16:00 print).

Sessions: 1097 of 1097 regular sessions simulated; missing chain files: []; errors: {}.
